online_purchase.title: Online Purchase Process
online_purchase.content: The validation of an order on our website implies knowledge and acceptance of the terms of use and purchase as expressed on this page. After completing the purchase, the customer will receive an email with the record of their order within a period of less than 24 hours.

warranty.title: Warranty
warranty.content: Our customer service department has an after-sales service to resolve any problems with our certification and verification service. If you have any questions about the use of Musicdibs, contact us at <email>info@musicdibs.com</email>.

cancel_purchase.title: Cancel Purchase
cancel_purchase.content: Given the customized and individualized nature of the services offered, it will not be possible to exercise the right of purchase cancellation, except in the case of purchasing credits for registrations "without subscription". To request cancellation within 14 days after purchase, send an email to <email>info@musicdibs.com</email> including: full name, ID of the identification document used in the registration process, username or email and order number.

refunds.title: Refunds
refunds.content: Customers have up to 30 calendar days to request a refund for their credit purchases, provided they have not used them. If more than 30 days have passed since your purchase or if part of the credits from the purchased package have been used, you will not be entitled to any type of refund.

subscription_conditions.title: Subscription Conditions
subscription_conditions.content: By confirming your subscription, you authorize iCommunity Labs Tech S.L. to make future charges to your card in accordance with these terms and conditions. You can cancel it at any time, but with a minimum of 24 hours before its renewal.

important.title: Important:
items: If you wish to cancel the renewal of a subscription, you must do so at least 24 hours before it is automatically renewed
The right of purchase cancellation does NOT apply to subscriptions

abuse_use.title: Abuse of Use
abuse_use.content: The resale or unauthorized use of credits acquired by third parties who are not the account owner is prohibited. In the case of unlimited subscriptions, monthly consumption will be monitored and use may be restricted if abusive use is detected.

nfts.title: NFTs
nfts.content: NFTs are limited as established in each subscription, with a maximum minting of up to 1,000 units per NFT. It is the sole responsibility of the user to provide the address of a wallet compatible with the Polygon network.

icom_tokens.title: Purchase using ICOM Tokens
icom_tokens.content: ICOMs are the utility tokens of iCommunity and can be used to purchase Musicdibs credits with a 20% discount on the original price of the chosen product.

offers_promotions.title: Offers and Promotions
offers_promotions.content: Offers available on the website are limited to the first 1000 purchases that pay for the product on offer, except in exceptional situations explicitly indicated in the promotion. Any offer will end when its defined time ends, or the available packages, whichever comes first.

policy.title: Cookie Policy
policy.content: The purpose of this cookie policy is to inform you clearly and accurately about the cookies used on the Musicdibs website, owned by iCommunity Labs Techs S.L.

what_are_cookies.title: What are Cookies?
what_are_cookies.content: A cookie is a small piece of text that the websites you visit send to the browser and that allows the website to remember information about your visit, such as your preferred language and other options, in order to facilitate your next visit and make the site more useful to you. Cookies play a very important role and contribute to a better browsing experience for the user.

items.title: Own cookies:
items.description: Sent from our domain

items.title: Third-party cookies:
items.description: Sent from external domains

items.title: Session cookies:
items.description: They are deleted when you close the browser

items.title: Persistent cookies:
items.description: They remain for a set period of time

items.title: Technical cookies:
items.description: Allow navigation and use of the website

items.title: Personalization cookies:
items.description: Allow access to the service with predefined characteristics

items.title: Analytical cookies:
items.description: Allow tracking and analysis of user behavior

items.title: Advertising cookies:
items.description: Allow management of advertising spaces

items.title: Behavioral advertising cookies:
items.description: Store information about user behavior

technical.title: Technical Cookies
technical.content: These are those that allow the user to navigate through a web page, platform or application and use the different options or services that exist there, such as, for example, controlling traffic and data communication, identifying the session, accessing restricted access parts, remembering the elements that make up an order, carrying out the purchase process of an order, making the request for registration or participation in an event, using security elements during navigation.

personalization.title: Personalization Cookies
personalization.content: These are those that allow the user to access the service with some general predefined characteristics based on a series of criteria on the user's terminal, such as the language, the service, the regional configuration from where the service is accessed, etc.

acceptance.title: Acceptance of the Cookie Policy
acceptance.content: By pressing the "I Accept" button, it is assumed that you accept the use of cookies. However, you can modify the cookie settings at any time from your browser.

configuration.title: How to Modify Cookie Settings
configuration.intro: You can restrict, block or delete cookies from the Musicdibs website or any other website using your browser. In each browser the operation is different, the "Help" function will show you how to do it.

browsers.title: Main Browsers:
items: Chrome: Settings → Privacy and security → Cookies
Edge: Settings → Cookies and site permissions

additional_info.title: Additional Information:
additional_info.content: For more information about cookies, you can consult the Guide on the use of cookies from the <link>Spanish Data Protection Agency</link>.
additional_info.link_aria_label: Guide on the use of cookies from the Spanish Data Protection Agency

updates.title: Updates and Changes to the Cookie Policy
updates.content_part1: iCommunity Labs Techs SL reserves the right to modify this Cookie Policy based on legislative, regulatory requirements, or in order to adapt said policy to the instructions issued by the Spanish Data Protection Agency, therefore it is recommended that users visit it periodically.
updates.content_part2: When significant changes occur in this Cookie Policy, they will be communicated to users either through the website or via email to registered users.
